visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a red tie-dye t-shirt, shorts, and a backpack stands on a wet concrete floor in a zoo environment. In the background, a large elephant with a mahout on its back sprays a powerful stream of water from its trunk directly onto the child, soaking his head and upper body. The setting is an outdoor animal park with lush green trees and a rocky enclosure wall under bright natural light. (2) A man wearing a black t-shirt and jeans enters the frame from the left, placing his hand on the child's shoulder to guide him closer to the elephants. They are positioned in front of a fenced elephant area where multiple elephants are visible. A yellow and purple sign reading "ANIMAL WONDER RESORT" is clearly visible on a building in the distant background. (3) The scene cuts to a closer shot of the child being sprayed repeatedly by the elephant's trunk in quick succession. The water forms a large, white misty splash around the boy's head and backpack. The child is squinting his eyes and smiling widely, showing a look of intense joy and excitement while his clothes become increasingly wet. (4) The child turns and runs toward the camera, away from the splash zone. He is laughing and hunched over slightly as he moves across the damp ground. The camera follows his movement to reveal a group of bystanders, including a woman holding a baby, a young girl in a pink shirt, and a man operating a professional camera with a large microphone attached.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched child's scream of excitement ("Whoo!") is immediately followed by a broad-spectrum, splashing sound of water. Upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop music with a bright synthesizer melody and a 4/4 electronic drum beat plays in the background at a moderate volume. (2) A new splashing sound of water hitting a surface triggers the next phase. An adult male voice with a friendly, high-arousal tone says "Hao jin oh" (so close) in Mandarin. The BGM remains steady and rhythmic. Faint outdoor birds and distant chatter are audible in the background atmosphere. (3) Three distinct, sharp, and rhythmic percussive splashing sounds occur in rapid succession, mimicking the spray of a water jet. The child continues to vocalize rhythmic "Whoo!" shouts that synchronize with the splashing events. The BGM maintains its energetic pace with a prominent kick drum. (4) The sound of the child's loud, joyful laughter and the fast-paced sound of wet footsteps on concrete mark the final phase. The adult male voice laughingly says "Po shui jie, po shui jie" (water splashing festival). Faint applause or laughter from a small group of bystanders is heard as the BGM fades slightly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a fun, memorable family travel experience involving a child interacting with elephants at a tourist resort. The video focuses on the joy and sensory excitement of the child being sprayed with water.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy short-form video with rapid editing and synchronized audio-visual cues to emphasize the 'water splash' moments.
